card.name: Linking words before malaria terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'of', 'where', 'by', 'against' and 'treat' in antimalarial drug labels, just before 'malaria' or 'Plasmodium' (vivax, falciparum).

modes.label: Of/against before malaria
modes.description: The word 'of' or 'against' sits right before a malaria or parasite term.
modes.example: Chloroquine phosphate tablets are not effective<< against>> chloroquine- or hydroxychlor

modes.label: Treat/where before malaria
modes.description: A verb or conjunction leads into the malaria setting, such as treating or an endemic area.
modes.example: of chloroquine phosphate suppressive therapy in an area<< where>> vivax malaria is endemic. Patients suffering
